risks.title: Geopolitical volatility and international operations
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at beginning of section (Item 1, Business Environment), strong language ('adversely affected', 'war', 'armed conflict', 'sanctions'), stable trend but heightened geopolitical context, geopolitical category heavyweight for global energy sector.

risks.title: Commodity dependence and supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central section (Raw materials), moderate language ('constraints', 'can trigger'), stable trend but acknowledges current vulnerabilities, industrial category relevant for energy services.

risks.title: Competitive intensity and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Risk in Markets and competition section (Item 1), direct language ('highly competitive markets', 'many substantial competitors'), stable trend, competition category heavyweight for energy services.

risks.title: Currency fluctuations and foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in Business Environment section, moderate language ('foreign currency exchange rates', 'highly inflationary currencies'), stable trend but relevant for operations in 70 countries, macro category heavyweight.

risks.title: Dependence on global talent retention
risks.score_rationale: Risk in Workforce section (Item 1), explicit language ('Our workforce is our top asset', 'attract and retain talent'), stable trend but acknowledges critical challenge, key person category heavyweight for labor-intensive services.

risks.title: Decline in fossil fuel energy demand
risks.score_rationale: Risk implicit in context (energy transition mentioned in highlights), indirect but strategic language ('sustainable energy future', 'low carbon energy business'), new/elevated trend, macro category existential for oil and gas sector.

risks.title: Partial divestiture of chemicals business
risks.score_rationale: Risk in Completion and Production section (Item 1), neutral language ('strategic decision to market for sale'), new trend (announced for H1 2026), capital category moderate weight.

ai_positioning.summary: HAL does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K report.
